aiReview.method: All canonical Japanese section paragraphs, lesson fields, question prompts/options/option-specific reasons and effective readings translated directly and semantically compared. aiReview.register: Respectful adult 您, stable Japanese names, no invented age/gender/kinship; Japanese glossary headwords/kana retained with Chinese definitions.
aiReview.terminology: 尿管=输尿管;尿道=尿道;尿意/便意 distinct. 陰部 rendered 外生殖器 or 外生殖器及其周围部位, avoiding a female-only assumption or equating anatomy with privacy. 差し込み便器=床上便盆;尿器=尿壶;ポータブルトイレ=便携式坐便器; constipation definitions retained from canonical amended Japanese.

Shared clothing/standing support requirements preserved; no unsupported invasive washing, catheter, enema or medication instruction introduced.
